title: Raiders sign backup Michael Mayer to $45 million extension as injuries pile up for Brock Bowers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders sign backup Michael Mayer to $45 million extension as injuries pile up for Brock Bowers
sources.description: The Raiders signed a tight end to a lucrative contract extension Saturday, but it was not injured Pro Bowler Brock Bowers.
